neighbours.label: endpoint marker of a span: ' to' / ' end' / ' since' that links the start of a time or space range to its end (from 1990 to 2005; start=None, end=None)
fire: The bridge was under construction from 1931 to 1937, when it finally opened.
Her term on the council lasted from 2009 to 2016 in total.
Ticket sales ran from March to June of that year.
